 singapore 2 taken to hospital after bus skids along Airport Road
 A bus reportedly skidded along Airport Road towards MacPherson Road on Friday morning. PHOTO: AsiaOne reader PUBLISHED ON October 30, 2026 5:04 AM BY Helmy Sa'at Two people were taken to hospital after a bus skidded along Airport Road on Friday (Oct 30) morning.
 The police said they were alerted to an accident involving a bus at about 6.55am on Airport Road towards MacPherson Road.
 The bus is believed to have skidded, they added.
 The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) said it was alerted to the accident at about 7am.
 A 57-year-old male bus driver and a 65-year-old male passenger were conscious when taken to Tan Tock Seng Hospital.
 The bus driver is assisting with police investigations.
 The affected lane was reopened at about 9.20am.
 Police investigations are ongoing.
